'''Quenelle''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who, in [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], was both the [[Margravine]] and secretly the [[Skull Queen]] of [[Nallastia]], a direct descendant of the [[Margrave Octan]]. During that year, her daughter, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Calvaria]], in her absence, kidnapped the [[Hondu Firewell|parents]] of the child [[Klay Firewell|Klay]]—for not only trespassing, but also allegedly violating Nallastia's sacred wildlife laws—and, per her wrongful decree, placed them inside an [[Force field/Legends|energy field]] created by ancient [[Trinity Stones]]. When the 18-year-old [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] crashed his [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]], Quenelle was recruited by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Bultar Swan/Legends|Bultar Swan]] to help locate him. But when she discovered, at [[Skull Queen's fortress|her fortress]], that Skywalker had befriended Klay and had taken Calvaria hostage in order to bargain for the release of the boy's parents, Quenelle revealed herself as the Skull Queen, chastised her daughter, then went hunting with Kenobi for the [[Lost Stars of Nallastia]]—three ancient jewels that could disable the energy field. The jewels were found within the [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]]-[[Moon/Legends|moon's]] [[Cavern of Screaming Skulls]] and Klay's parents set free.<ref name="skulls">''[[Star Wars Adventures 2: The Cavern of Screaming Skulls]]''</ref>

During the subsequent celebration at the Queen's fortress, the [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]] shipbuilder [[Groodo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] took over a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on nearby [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]], where he took Calvaria hostage. Quenelle traveled with Swan and the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] to take the [[Fondor Spaceport|spaceport]] back and rescue Calvaria. Their mission was a success, and the greedy Hutt and his cohorts—[[Hurlo Holowan]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Rodd]] of Fondor—fled. Quenelle kissed Kenobi goodbye before he returned to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], upset that she couldn't [[Marriage/Legends|marry]] him.<ref name="hostage">''[[Star Wars Adventures 3: The Hostage Princess]]''</ref>

Quenelle owned a Nallastian [[rescue runner]], the salvage ship she arrived in to negotiate salvage rights to the [[False Sun Runner|alleged]] ancient vessel, the ''[[Sun Runner]]''. Her salvage-rights opponent was Senator Rodd. The negotiations were monitored by Swan, Kenobi, and Skywalker.<ref name="Star Wars Adventures 1: Hunt the Sun Runner" />

Quenelle issued sentences of [[Death/Legends|death]] to poachers of Nallastian wildlife, which the Nallastians considered sacred: creatures such as the [[venrap]], [[grillik]], or [[killspike]].<ref name="skulls" />
